title: Bol rahi hai zainab
body:
Bol rahi hai zainab
Khatm hai fasl e kamaa bol rahi hai zainab..(3)
<<DIVIDER>>
Kaun boleyga jahaa bol rahi hai zainab.
1. Teer o shamsheer o sina hoke sitam ke lashkar..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Thak gayi sab ki zabaa bol rahi hai zainab.
2. Muddato baad sunaa phirse ali ka lehjaa..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Kaisey jhoomey na azaa bol rahi hai zainab.
3. Chun rahaa hai adab e nahj e balagha lafze..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Apne baba ki zabaan bol rahi hai zainab.
4. Hogayi jeet bahattar(72) shohadaa ki saabit..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Leke gaazi ka nishaan bol rahi hai zainab.
5. Aye yazeed isse badi haar teri kya hogi..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Wo tera ghar hai jahaan bol rahi hai zainab.
author: Mir Hassan Mir
